title: Trump's FDA pick Overton good for psychedelics, new pain meds but bad for vaccines: Analysts

title: Moderna stock nearly doubles as Merck-partnered mRNA cancer vaccine meets Phase 3 goal
snippet: Melanoma was slower to recur in patients receiving Merck and Moderna's mRNA vaccine with Keytruda, supporting use of the combination in adjuvant treatment. The partners plan to take the data to the FDA.

title: Trump picks White House aide Heidi Overton as FDA chief: Reports
